shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat surface
repeated animals arranged in a row/register
quadruped with head shown in profile
justification: Both surfaces show animals in profile in low relief with repeated elements arranged in horizontal bands, but that is about as generic as relief iconography gets. A shows a naturalistic procession of human figures leading horned rams with carefully rendered fleece, hair and drapery, while B shows schematic, isolated predators, birds and abstract signs stacked in stratified registers with no human figures and no interaction between animals and people.
